Artist.description: A performer who records at the studio, known by the name they release under.

Engineer.description: A studio staff member: producer, engineer or assistant. A first name alone is not an identity.

Collab.description: One artist's credit on another's work: a guest feature, or a remix.

Engagement.description: What a staff member does for an artist: produce their record, or mix it.

Session.description: A block of studio time for an artist. booked_by made the booking, engineer runs the desk, assistant helps; status is on_hold, booked, finished or scrapped.

Clearance.description: Permission to use a sample in an artist's track. cleared stays empty until clearance is recorded.

questions.q: Which sessions did Ezequiel Funes book?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Engineer)<-[:booked_by]-(n1:Session) WHERE n0.name = 'Ezequiel Funes' RETURN n1.title AS title

questions.q: Which sessions am I assisting on?

questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Engineer)<-[:assistant]-(n1:Session) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.title AS title

questions.q: How many hours did the Lowtide vocals take?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Session) WHERE n0.title = 'Lowtide vocals' RETURN n0.hours AS hours

questions.q: Is there a record of tape being used for the Gravel Hymn tracking?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Session) WHERE n0.title = 'Gravel Hymn tracking' RETURN coalesce(n0.tape_used, false) AS tape_used

questions.q: Has Ayodele Martins's choir sample been cleared?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Artist)<-[:artist]-(n1:Clearance) WHERE n0.moniker = 'Ayodele Martins' AND n1.sample CONTAINS 'choir' RETURN n1.cleared AS cleared

questions.q: What sample and fee does each clearance list?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Clearance) RETURN n0.sample AS sample, n0.fee AS fee
